title: Geometric turbulence: a geodesic-regression crisis indicator for equity covariance dynamics, with evidence from African markets
summary: The covariance matrix of a basket of assets is a symmetric positive-definite object that evolves on a curved manifold, not on a flat vector space. Standard linear regression on its vectorised entries ignores that geometry and, in periods of market stress, can return fits that fail to be positive definite. We study geodesic regression on the symmetric positive-definite cone $\SPD(n)$ under the log-Euclidean and affine-invariant metrics, with the rolling sample covariance of a basket of log-returns as data. The fitted geodesic's velocity norm is proposed as a geometry-aware turbulence…
